privacy.description: How Coursition handles your account, the material you upload and the course drafts we generate from it.
privacy.lead: Short version: we keep your account, the files you upload and the courses you build from them. We use that to run the product for you, and for nothing else.

ai.body: Drafting a course means sending the text of your sources to the AI provider we use for generation. That provider processes the text to return a draft and works only on our instructions. Please do not upload material you are not allowed to hand to an external processor.
ai.title: Sending your material to an AI model

business.body: If your organisation bought Coursition under a signed agreement, your organisation decides what happens to the data in its workspace and we act as its processor under the data processing terms of that agreement. In that case ask your organisation for its own privacy notice.
business.title: If you use Coursition through your employer

changes.body: If we change how we handle your data, we update this page and the date at the top of it. If a change materially affects you, we tell you before it takes effect.
changes.title: Changes to this notice

cookies.body: We only set the cookies the site needs to work: one that keeps you signed in, one that remembers the language you chose, and one that remembers whether you picked the light or dark theme. There is no advertising and no third-party analytics.
cookies.title: Cookies

data.body: We collect three things, and only these:

items.account: Your account: name, email address and password. Passwords are stored hashed, never in readable form.
items.content: Your work: the files and text you upload as source material, and the course drafts generated from them.
items.technical: Session data: the IP address and browser your sign-ins come from, so we can spot suspicious access to your account.

data.title: What we collect

purposes.body: We use your data to run your account, to generate and store your course drafts, to keep the service secure, and to answer you when you contact us. The legal basis is performing our agreement with you, plus our legitimate interest in keeping the service safe and working. We do not profile you and we do not use your material to train models of our own.
purposes.title: Why we use it

retention.body: Your account data lives as long as your account does. Source files and course drafts stay until you delete them or delete your account, after which they are removed from storage. We keep invoicing records for as long as Czech accounting and tax law requires.
retention.title: How long we keep it

rights.body: Under the GDPR you can ask us to:

items.access: tell you what data we hold about you and give you a copy,
items.complaint: and you can complain to the Czech Data Protection Authority (Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů, uoou.gov.cz) if you think we got it wrong.
items.deletion: delete your account and everything in it,
items.objection: stop or limit a particular use of your data,
items.portability: hand your data over in a portable format,

rights.title: Your rights

scope.body: This page explains what Coursition does with personal data when you sign up and use the course studio yourself. It is written for people, not for lawyers, and it describes what the product actually does today.
scope.title: What this page covers

sharing.body: We do not sell personal data and we do not share it for marketing. We use service providers to host the application, store your files and run AI generation; they process data only on our instructions and only to keep the product running. We hand data to authorities only when the law obliges us to.
sharing.title: Who else sees it

privacy.title: Privacy

terms.description: The rules for using the Coursition course studio: what we provide, what you are responsible for, and what happens if something goes wrong.
terms.lead: Short version: your material and your courses stay yours, the studio stays ours, and every draft the AI produces is yours to check before you teach from it.

acceptableUse.body: While using Coursition, please do not:

items.abuse: try to break, overload, or get around the security of the service.
items.resell: resell, rent out or sublicense access to the studio,
items.reverseEngineer: copy, reverse engineer or rebuild the software behind it,
items.unlawful: upload unlawful material or material you have no right to use,

acceptableUse.title: What you must not do

account.body: You need an account to use the studio. Give us a working email address, keep your password to yourself, and treat everything done through your account as done by you. Tell us at info@coursition.com if you think someone else got in.
account.title: Your account

ai.body: Course drafts are produced by AI models. They can be wrong, incomplete or one-sided, and AI output is not always protected by copyright. Read and edit every draft before you put it in front of learners. Coursition is a drafting tool, not a substitute for your judgement.
ai.title: AI-generated drafts

availability.body: We work to keep Coursition up, but the service is provided as it is. We may change, add or retire features, and we do not promise uninterrupted or error-free operation. Keep your own copy of anything you cannot afford to lose.
availability.title: Availability

business.body: If your organisation signed a separate written agreement with us, that agreement governs its use of Coursition and these terms only fill the gaps it leaves.
business.title: Business customers

changes.body: We may update these terms. The date at the top of this page shows the current version, and we tell you before a material change takes effect. If you do not accept a change, you can close your account.
changes.title: Changes to these terms

law.body: Czech law applies. We would rather sort a disagreement out by talking to you; if that fails, it is decided by the Czech court with jurisdiction over Coursition's registered office.
law.title: Governing law

liability.body: We are liable for damage we cause intentionally or by gross negligence, and for anything the law does not allow us to exclude. Beyond that we are not liable for lost profit, lost data, or the consequences of publishing a course draft you did not review.
liability.title: Liability

scope.body: These terms apply when you create a Coursition account and use the course studio yourself. They are an agreement between you and Coursition s.r.o.
scope.title: Who these terms are between

service.body: Coursition takes the material you upload and drafts learning objectives, an activity plan and course content from it. You review and edit every step, and nothing is published anywhere by us.
service.title: What Coursition does

termination.body: You can delete your account whenever you like. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms or is used unlawfully, and we will tell you why unless the law stops us. After closure we delete the content in the account.
termination.title: Ending the agreement

yourContent.body: Your source material stays yours, and so do the courses you build from it. You give us permission to store and process that material for one purpose only: running the service for you. By uploading, you confirm you are allowed to use the material and to have us process it.
yourContent.title: Your material and your courses
